summary: The buffered OpenRouter Responses path now records incomplete and failed payloads as non-completed terminals; no actionable defects found.

evidence: src/provider/openrouter-handlers.ts maps payload.status values incomplete and failed to non-completed terminal types and passes the corresponding completion flag.
src/openai-telemetry.ts forwards that flag to terminal usage telemetry, preventing the terminal wrapper from treating truncated or failed buffered responses as successful.
